if(DOXYGEN_DOT_FOUND)
    set(DOXYGEN_HAVE_DOT "YES")
else()
    set(DOXYGEN_HAVE_DOT "NO")
endif()

set(DOXYGEN_IN ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Doxyfile.in)
set(DOXYGEN_OUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Doxyfile)

configure_file(${DOXYGEN_IN} ${DOXYGEN_OUT} @ONLY)

# The gallery images (docs/images, generated by --export-gallery) are copied next to the HTML pages at the paths
# the pages use: docs/images/ for the main page (README.md) and images/ for the guides in docs/ (docs/widgets.md);
# Doxygen writes every page into html/ itself.
set(DOXYGEN_HTML_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/html)

add_custom_target(docs
    COMMAND ${DOXYGEN_EXECUTABLE} ${DOXYGEN_OUT}
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/images ${DOXYGEN_HTML_DIR}/docs/images
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/images ${DOXYGEN_HTML_DIR}/images
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    COMMENT "Generating API documentation with Doxygen"
    VERBATIM
)

# The GitHub Pages site: the landing page (docs/site) at the root, the Doxygen output under api/, and a redirect
# stub at the old root address of every Doxygen page (see docs/site/assemble_site.cmake)
set(QIW_SITE_DIR ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/site)
add_custom_target(site
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            -DHTML_DIR=${DOXYGEN_HTML_DIR}
            -DSITE_SOURCE_DIR=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/site
            -DSITE_DIR=${QIW_SITE_DIR}
            -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/site/assemble_site.cmake
    COMMENT "Assembling the GitHub Pages site in ${QIW_SITE_DIR}"
    VERBATIM
)
add_dependencies(site docs)
